protocol.prompts: 50 dev_eval prompts drawn with seed 7, 3 more as warm-ups
protocol.request: chat completions with EvalKit's answer schema (response_format json_schema)
deviations: context 8192 (ggh serve's --ctx-size), not llama-server's default: §8 asks for both
cache_prompt false, so every prompt is processed fresh (EvalKit's request leaves the server default, prompt caching on)
max_tokens 256 per §8 (EvalKit sends max_completion_tokens 2048) and temperature 0 (the server is already greedy: --temp 0 --top-k 1)
output laptop_bench.json with a measured_at stamp, not §8's laptop-bench-<date>.json
protocol.llama_bench: -p 512 -n 128 -ngl 999 -r 5, run on every variant in turn for 3 rounds before the workloads; each value is the median across rounds

metrics.ttft_ms: server prompt_ms plus one generated token's mean time
metrics.gen_tps: server predicted_per_second per request; its p95 is the fast tail
metrics.aggregate: median across repetitions of each repetition's p50 (or p95)
metrics.peak_rss_mb: ps rss of the llama-server process every 50 ms from /health to shutdown; on Apple Silicon it may leave out Metal private buffers such as the KV cache
